name: Cross-asset capitulation composite long (Fear&Greed + VIX)
rationale: A composite contrarian-capitulation entry that requires BOTH gauges to flag fear at once: crypto's own Fear & Greed in its fear band AND equity VIX elevated. The thesis is selectivity — a true cross-asset risk flush (both the crypto crowd AND the equity-vol market in fear) is a rarer, higher-conviction capitulation than either alone, so requiring confluence should raise the post-flush hit-rate and cut whipsaw. Both features are BOUNDED and mean-reverting (no drifting-level trap), and the confluence makes this the LOWEST-turnover of the capitulation family — fees barely bite. Hypothesis: enter LONG spot when both gauges are fearful, exit when EITHER normalizes (sentiment recovers OR vol calms) or risk limits hit. Disconfirmer 1 (does confluence beat the single signals?): the standalone Fear&Greed and standalone VIX specs are in the same cohort — if neither AND-confluence improves the deflated Sharpe over the better single signal, the composite adds nothing and is just over-fitting two filters. Disconfirmer 2 (trade count): requiring two extremes is rare; if it generates too few trades to clear the Gate's minimum, that is an honest 'insufficient evidence', not an edge. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): the recent purged+embargoed slice must stay positive or it is cycle-position-in-disguise. The Gate disposes; an honest FAIL is valid.
catalyst: crypto Fear&Greed in the fear band AND equity VIX elevated simultaneously
